mapper.sql: plan_id, plan_no, plan_name, plan_type, plan_status, org_id, start_date, end_date, total_income, total_expense, net_cash_flow, completion_rate, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, submit_user, submit_date, approval_user, approval_date, approval_opinion, execute_user, execute_date, complete_user, complete_date, cancel_user, cancel_date, description, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE plan_type = #{planType} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE plan_status = #{planStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE start_date >= #{startDate} AND end_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY start_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND plan_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' ORDER BY submit_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND plan_status = 'EXECUTING' ORDER BY execute_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND plan_status IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING') AND end_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY end_date ASC
SELECT plan_status as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY plan_status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT plan_type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY plan_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT 'OVERDUE' as warningType, COUNT(*) as count, '逾期计划' as description FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND plan_status IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING') AND end_date < CURDATE()
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LOW_COMPLETION' as warningType, COUNT(*) as count, '低完成率计划' as description FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND plan_status = 'COMPLETED' AND completion_rate < 80
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PENDING_APPROVAL' as warningType, COUNT(*) as count, '待审批计划' as description FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND plan_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), submit_date) > 3
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan SET plan_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', submit_user = #{submitUser}, submit_date = #{submitDate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE fund_plan SET plan_status = 'APPROVED', approval_user = #{approvalUser}, approval_date = #{approvalDate}, approval_opinion = #{approvalOpinion}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE fund_plan SET plan_status = 'REJECTED', approval_user = #{approvalUser}, approval_date = #{approvalDate}, approval_opinion = #{approvalOpinion}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE fund_plan SET plan_status = 'EXECUTING', execute_user = #{executeUser}, execute_date = #{executeDate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE fund_plan SET plan_status = 'COMPLETED', complete_user = #{completeUser}, complete_date = #{completeDate}, completion_rate = #{completionRate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE fund_plan SET plan_status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_user = #{cancelUser}, cancel_date = #{cancelDate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(plan_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM fund_plan WHERE plan_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
SELECT FROM fund_plan WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND (create_user = #{userId} OR submit_user = #{userId} OR execute_user = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time DESC
